title: More Hats
description: 🎩 More Hats — adds many different hats to the minecraft
body:
#  🎩 More Hats for Your Adventure!

**This pack adds a variety of new custom hats to the game, allowing you to give your character a unique look and stand out from other players.**


 **✨ The collection will continue to grow over time, with even more hats planned for future updates.**

 **💖 We hope you enjoy the pack and find your favorite hat!**
